$comment: Switch-on plan for Vercel production (strelva-admin). Generated with design-notes/SWITCH-ON.md. Names and values only; no secrets. 'rollback' is the value to set to undo; an empty string means remove the variable. Each rollback assumes the variable was unset before; if step 0 read another value, roll back to that value instead. 'from' is what the vault records, 'unknown' where nothing is recorded: confirm with step 0 before changing.

decisions.email: Owner claim and Needs you only, to owner addresses confirmed in data. Booking, inquiry, reminder and marketing email off. The 6 candidate owner emails in the vault are unconfirmed: never record them as confirmed, never send to them.
decisions.money: Honest not yet. No price, no Stripe switch-on.
decisions.external: Google Business Profile writes, provider keys (HighLevel, Microsoft, Instagram) and Dental vertical_intake stay off and render honestly.

step0: vercel env pull --environment=production into a temp file, then: pnpm tsx scripts/prod-flag-report.ts <file> (names and normalized states only). Replace every 'unknown' 'from' below with what it reports.

Read-only: list reb:client-email:* in Redis and tenant_settings rows with recordId client_email. Every value must be inherit or off. An 'on' arms ALL client email for that tenant (send.ts audience gate), so set it to inherit before deploy 2 (rollback: its previous value).
Read-only: confirm the 29 held migrations from MIGRATION-PLAN.md are applied, including 20261028120000_owner_email_confirmations.sql, before the deploy that sets their flags.

phases.after: After sites-by-code 20261027120000..120300 (120100 before or with the code)
Deploy 2, email. After 20261028120000 (owner email confirmations) and after Jacob has confirmed at least one owner address in data. Same deploy carries every line below.

perTenantOverrides.why: An 'on' override arms every client-audience email for that tenant, bypassing the global switch. 'off' silences that business's owner streams too.

perTenantOverrides.key: public.owner_email_confirmations (one row per Jacob-confirmed owner address and business)
perTenantOverrides.to: select public.confirm_owner_email(<operator user id>, <operator verified email>, <business workspace id>, <owner email>, <how Jacob confirmed it>) for each address Jacob confirms
perTenantOverrides.rollback: select public.revoke_owner_email_confirmation(<operator user id>, <operator verified email>, <business workspace id>, <owner email>)
perTenantOverrides.why: The transport mails a claim or Needs you email only to an address confirmed here or to the business's own signed-in owner. None of the 6 vault candidates may be added until Jacob confirms that exact address.

perTenantOverrides.from: systems: one business 'off' (vault Oct 14); others unknown
perTenantOverrides.why: Env '1' means on except where a row says off; rows stay the per-business kill switch.

rollback.email: Set STRELVA_OWNER_EMAIL_STREAMS to empty (remove it) and redeploy fresh: every owner stream send is held at once. Revoking a confirmation stops mail to that address without a deploy.
rollback.flags: Set each changed variable to its rollback value and make a fresh production deploy (env changes need a new deploy, not a redeploy). Or promote the previous deployment.
rollback.migration: rollback-20261028120000_owner_email_confirmations.sql drops the table and RPCs; with owner_email_confirmed gone every stream send is held.
